description: Add an umbrella scoping header before Step 0 in cam-review.md (both copies) so the manual /cam-review path scope is unmistakable at the section level, not just the intro paragraph.

userStories.title: Add umbrella manual-path scoping header before Step 0
userStories.description: As a reader of cam-review.md, I need a section-level header that scopes Steps 0-5 as the manual /cam-review path so that I can see the manual-vs-sidecar scoping from the nearby section structure, not only from the intro paragraph at line 9.
acceptanceCriteria: An umbrella scoping header is added to .claude/commands/cam-review.md immediately before 'Step 0' (e.g. '## Manual /cam-review flow (Steps 0-5)') plus a one-line reminder that everything below is the manual path and the sidecar's autonomous per-story pass does not read this file. [oracle: grep -qi 'Manual /cam-review flow' .claude/commands/cam-review.md]

The new header appears before the 'Step 0' heading in the file (section-level scoping precedes the first step). [oracle: file-assert awk '/Manual \/cam-review flow/{h=NR} /## Step 0/{s=NR} END{exit !(h && s && h<s)}' .claude/commands/cam-review.md]

No step content, prompt contract, or verdict/triage logic is changed; the edit is scoping/wording only (net addition is the new header block, existing Step 0-5 bodies unchanged). [oracle: reviewer-judgment]

The flow is NOT framed as deprecated/dead: the manual /cam-review path is live (src/commands/review.ts) and the doc still describes the orchestrator-context Task() spawn of subagent-reviewer. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]
templates/commands/cam-review.md receives the identical change and the two copies remain byte-identical. [oracle: diff .claude/commands/cam-review.md templates/commands/cam-review.md]
Vendor drift check passes (bun run embed-vendor:check); regenerate with bun run embed-vendor if the templates/ change requires it. [oracle: bun run embed-vendor:check]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test), including any embedded-vendor / doc-gate assertions over cam-review.md. [oracle: bun test]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Files: .claude/commands/cam-review.md and templates/commands/cam-review.md (byte-identical today, verified; both MUST get the same edit or a doc-gate/diff drifts). Insert a single '## Manual /cam-review flow (Steps 0-5)' H2 header + one-line reminder immediately before the existing '## Step 0: Read review state from PRD' heading (currently at line 13). templates/commands/ IS embedded via the vendor blob (scripts/generate-embedded-vendor.ts -> src/templates/embedded.ts), so run bun run embed-vendor after editing templates/ or embed-vendor:check fails. GOTCHAS (from issue spec): (1) do NOT frame the flow as deprecated -- it is live per src/commands/review.ts; goal is scoping clarity only. (2) Reject per-step 'manual path' reminders (repetitive) and a full H2->H3 reflow of every step (heavier than asked); a single umbrella header is the right-sized change. The existing intro paragraph at line 9 already states the manual/sidecar relationship -- keep it; the header just surfaces that scoping at section level.
